test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**however**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option is '**however**.'
 
• '**however**' is used used to open a sentence that contrasts with or appears to contradict a preceding statement.
 
• '**whenever**' is used to refer to a time and situation that happens. 
 
• '**wherever**' is used to join two clauses. 
 
• '**whatever**' is used to highlight a lack of limitations when referring to any object or sum, regardless of size.
